Anika Rao: kicking off kintsugi-v0.5 int4 bring-up. quick smoke across multilocale evals flagged weird truncation for JP furigana + Arabic mirrored brackets in some samples. not catastrophic but surprising.
Tom Becker: can you share a repro and the eval split? which tokenizer variant are we using (baseline spm v1.0 or locale-patched)?
Anika Rao: using locale-patched spm v1.2. repro snippets: ```jp: 今日は山田さんの書いた本を読みました（ふりがな：やまだ）。。。
zh: 今天早上吃了包子，然後去了公園。
ar: مرحبا (هل هذا [اختبار])؟``` note: jp shows furigana in parentheses then  narrow no-break space around Chinese comma, ar shows bracket orientation flip.
sora-bot: queued eval job kintsugi-v0.5-int4-multilang-qa (job 9122)
Liu Wei: odd — narrow NBSP (U+202F/U+00A0) treatment often differs across detok codepaths. could be a detok map loss where U+202F gets normalized to ordinary space pre-tokenize then collapsed on detok. do we see token id splits for furigana parentheses?
Tom Becker: initial diff: int4 vs fp16 for 2k samples: mean BLEU -0.25, but JP subset shows -0.9 and AR subset -0.6. examining token ids for the JP sentence: fp16 token ids end with [824, 305, 991] (ellipsis token maintained), int4 ends with [824, 305] (ellipsis dropped).
Anika Rao: interesting — we also saw occasional bracket mirror: closing square becomes opening after detok for Arabic routes. likely bidi/directionality detok bug.
Liu Wei: possible root causes: 1) quant table rounding merges ellipsis with trailing furigana grapheme, 2) detok normalizer applies NFKC on some codepaths causing bracket orientation change, 3) kvcache evictions mid-sentence cause partial output.
Tom Becker: cheap quick checks I ran: tokenizer.serialize(jp_sample) -> matches across runtimes; the model logits differ right after the furigana token. I'll run generate with --raw-detok to inspect raw token->byte mapping.
Anika Rao: I filed infra job to run parity with different quant backend: int4-fused vs int4-slow. also adding a test in qa-suite to include narrow NBSP and furigana in the smoke set. ticket: https://redwood.internal/issue/9340
Liu Wei: for Arabic bracket flip, add a small bidi-aware detok guard: preserve mirrored bracket codepoints until final pass. patch is tiny and can be toggled per-route.
sora-bot: parity run complete: int4-fused vs fp16 (locale set): JP BLEU delta -0.88, AR -0.63, ZH -0.12. 11% of JP samples had lost trailing ellipses or furigana suffix.
Tom Becker: next steps: 1) reproduce with int4-slow to confirm kernel rounding, 2) add detok guard for mirrored pairs (toggleable), 3) add regression test and landing it to canary.
Anika Rao: putting a temporary rule in routing: jp/ja and ar routes to fallback fp16 if BLEU on canary drops >0.5. will revert once kernel or detok patch lands. :spiral_note_pad:
Liu Wei: I'll prototype detok guard and a small token-preserve map for U+2026 + furigana parentheses. if kernel rounding still fails we'll escalate to quant team.
Tom Becker: thanks team. keeping this thread for updates. short-term mitigation = detok preserve + routing fallback. long-term = kernel fix + qa coverage. :thumbsup:
